problem_type: stale Agent model catalog after credential onboarding
symptom: After a credential is saved through the existing model catalog bridge, the visible Agent composer continues to show no selectable text model and cannot expose the configured APIMart model.
direct_cause: ProjectAgentResidentShell loads text models once on mount with an effect that has no catalog-change subscription; later credential writes update disk and the bridge but leave the shell's local model list empty.
class_root: The Agent model picker had no shared refresh boundary for catalog mutations, so any provider credential/model change occurring after the resident mounted could leave its selectable model projection stale.
affected_population: Users who save or change a provider credential while the resident Agent is already mounted
The M0-M5 vertical-spine runner that enables Agent first and then configures APIMart
entry_points: Visible Settings/model-catalog credential write while the resident Agent is mounted
Visible Agent model menu opening after a catalog refresh
internal_only_reason: The stale projection is an internal React/catalog event lifecycle invariant; no external dependency controls it.
invariants: Every mounted ProjectAgentResidentShell refreshes its usable text-model projection when the canonical nomi-model-catalog-changed event fires.
A refresh cannot let an older in-flight catalog read overwrite a newer read.
The visible model menu remains the only model-selection path and exposes the full vendor/model identity after refresh.
generality_proof: Credential, model, and mapping onboarding all publish the same nomi-model-catalog-changed event; subscribing at the resident shell's shared catalog-read boundary covers every provider and mutation without provider-specific branches or model preference injection.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own one catalog read/derive path, subscribe it to nomi-model-catalog-changed, and discard stale asynchronous reads.
Keep the event subscription and cleanup structurally covered at the resident boundary.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: The shell's canonical catalog effect now reloads on nomi-model-catalog-changed and guards request order.
This picker already subscribes to nomi-model-catalog-changed and was used as the existing event contract.
The drawer is a producer of the canonical catalog-change event, not a resident model projection consumer.

recurrence.reason: Any provider credential or model mutation can occur after the resident mounts and reproduce the stale empty projection.
same_class_scan: Searched all nomi-model-catalog-changed producers and consumers under src/ and electron/.
Compared ProjectAgentResidentShell's one-shot effect with AssistantModelPicker's existing event subscription.
Checked the visible model menu's identity encoding and the shared filterUsableAssistantTextModels gate.

prevention.invariant: The resident reloads and re-derives selectable text models for every canonical catalog-change event, with last-request-wins ordering.
prevention.failure_mode: If the catalog read fails, the resident exposes no selectable models; stale reads cannot overwrite a newer successful refresh.
prevention.strategy: Subscribe the existing resident catalog read to the existing canonical event and guard asynchronous ordering at that single consumer boundary.

legacy_paths.rationale: The one-shot effect implementation is replaced in place at the same resident boundary; there is no separately callable legacy picker path.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: The defect is an internal React event subscription and asynchronous state ordering issue.

migration: No persisted catalog migration is needed; the resident re-reads the current canonical catalog after each mutation.
residual_risks: A real-key run must still verify that the APIMart text request itself completes; this fix only restores the visible model selection boundary and does not call a provider during tests.
